propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria are dropped at five architectural seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission.
The eight child tickets repair each seam with disjoint production-file ownership and shared end-to-end test coverage.
Project criteria must retain their logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id through Round A execution and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing.
The eval/calibration API and CLI must admit active project code-review criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous project ids.
The project-criterion runtime contract and extension API are documented and proven in live Gerrit advisory reviews.
